data.title: Colors — Starter · Lesson 3
data.subject: colors
data.lyrics:
🎉 ¡Es la hora!

[Hook]
Come on… Venga
Dance with me… Baila conmigo
Colors everywhere… Colores por todos lados
We're spinning around… Estamos girando
Birthday magic in the air… Magia de cumpleaños en el aire
Red… Rojo, purple… Morado, let's go… Vamos.

[Verse]
Balloons flying up so high, globos volando tan alto
Purple… Púrpura, gold… Dorado, shining in the sky.
Pink… Rosado, like the frosting on the cake, 
Naranja and orange… Naranja, it's a colorful fate.
Gray… Gris clouds far away, but here comes the sun, 
Ivory… Marfil and ivory dreams, under the golden one.
Salmon… Salmón and salmon shades, in the party lights, 
Emerald… Esmeralda and emerald vibes, feeling so right.

[Hook]
Come on… Venga
Dance with me… Baila conmigo
Colors everywhere… Colores por todos lados
We're spinning around… Estamos girando
Birthday magic in the air… Magia de cumpleaños en el aire
Red… Rojo, purple… Morado, let's go… Vamos.

[Verse]
Amber… Ámbar, like the candles burning bright,
